relationships.subject: degenerative IVD conditioned media
relationships.evidence_quote: we demonstrated that both degenerative IVD conditioned media and degenerative IVD acidic pH levels induced elevated nociceptive neuron activation in response to physiologic levels of mechanical strain

relationships.subject: IL-6
relationships.evidence_quote: In addition, interleukin 6 (IL-6) was demonstrated to mediate degenerative IVD conditioned media induced elevated nociceptive neuron activation.

relationships.subject: acidic pH
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP+ neurons subjected to cyclic strain in the presence of low pH showed a significantly increased percentage of neurons exhibiting calcium transients

key_findings: Degenerative IVD conditioned media and acidic pH independently sensitize DRG neurons (including CGRP+) to cyclic tensile strain.
novel_terms: discogenic pain in vitro strain model
